# Monaco editor styles

`editor.main.css` is the stylesheet of monaco-editor 0.55.1, the editor the app uses, copied from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.55.1/min/vs/editor/editor.main.css so the landing page can draw the editor
without loading it from a CDN. It is under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`, Copyright (c) 2016 - present Microsoft Corporation).
